sentences.text: Plesiohadros is an extinct genus of hadrosauroid dinosaur named for its resemblance to hadrosaurids.
It is the only known hadrosaur species found in the Alagteeg Formation.
The genus is known from a partial skeleton including a skull found at the Alag Teg locality in southern Mongolia.
Plesiohadros is classified within the family Hadrosauridae.
Plesiohadros lived during the late Cretaceous, approximately 80 to 75 million years ago, in what is now Asia.
The time range for Plesiohadros extends from the Santonian to the Campanian stages, between 85.7 and 72.2 million years ago.
